Character selection, character creation and arrival points for **ESX Legacy,
QBCore and Qbox** — one resource, framework detected automatically.

It replaces `esx_multicharacter` / `qb-multicharacter` / Qbox's built-in
character screen, and folds in the identity and appearance steps that
`esx_identity`, `esx_skin` and the QB clothing creators normally handle, so a new
player goes from connect to in-world through a single screen.

- **Selection** — your characters stand side by side as real peds. The camera is
  fixed; picking a card slides the line along, so slot 1 and slot 20 are framed
  identically however many slots you sell.
- **Creation** — a nine-step editor driving the live ped. On ESX it drives
  `skinchanger`, so the result is a normal ESX skin. On QBCore and Qbox it drives
  the ped directly, needs no appearance resource, and writes to `playerskins` so
  your barbers and clothes shops see it.
- **Arrival** — a rail of illustrated spawn cards, with the camera flying out to
  the highlighted location. Characters who own a property get a card for it.
- **Membership** — slots and sidebar rank resolved per account from Tebex
  purchases, Discord roles, ACE and staff grants.
